question: Which visa applicants have to submit a tuberculosis test certificate at a Korean diplomatic mission?
reference: Nationals of high TB-burden countries who live in one of those countries and apply for a long-term visa (stay of 91 days or longer) at a diplomatic mission.
answer: Nationals of high TB-burden countries applying for a long-term visa (stay period of 91 days or longer) at a diplomatic mission must submit the certificate [2]. Applicants from Nepal, East Timor, Russia, Malaysia, Mongolia, Myanmar, Bangladesh, Vietnam, Sri Lanka, Uzbekistan, India, Indonesia, China, Cambodia, Kyrgyzstan, Thailand, Pakistan, and Philippines fall under this requirement [1]. This requirement applies to nationals living in their respective high TB-burden countries of residence [2]. Applicants from other countries are not required to submit the certificate unless they meet specific exemption exceptions listed for certain statuses or dates [1].

question: Who issues the TB certificate for someone already in Korea who applies for a change of status of stay, and how is that different from a visa application abroad?
reference: In Korea (change of status, alien registration, extension) it is a certificate of confirmation issued by a Korean public health center; for a visa application at a mission it is a Certificate of Health from a hospital designated by the Korean diplomatic mission.
answer: For someone already in Korea applying for a change of status of stay, the TB certificate is issued by a Korean public health center [1]. This differs from a visa application abroad, where the certificate must be issued by a hospital designated by Korean diplomatic missions [1]. The foreign-issued certificate must include at least one test result such as a chest X-ray or sputum test [1], while the domestic certificate is a certificate of confirmation [1].

question: im chinese but i live in the US, do i need the tb paper for a long term korean visa?
reference: No. Chinese nationals living in the U.S. are not required to submit it; only those living in a high TB-burden country are.
answer: No, you do not need the TB test certificate for a long-term Korean visa. According to passage [1], nationals of high TB-burden countries living in China are required to submit the TB test certificate when applying for a long-term visa at a diplomatic mission, but Chinese nationals living in the U.S. are exempt from this requirement.

question: Do registered foreign residents need a re-entry permit to return to Korea within one year?
reference: No. Registered foreign residents departing after April 1, 2022 can re-enter within 1 year of departure without a re-entry permit (2 years for permanent residents).
answer: No, registered foreign residents departing after April 1, 2022 are allowed re-entry into Korea within one year without obtaining a re-entry permit in advance [1]. This exemption applies to status holders from Diplomat (A-1) through International Agreement (A-3), Korean Arts and Culture (D-1) through Dependent Family (F-3), Marriage Migrant (F-6) through Work and Visit (H-2) [1].

citations.snippet:

from the date of departure, without obtaining a Re-entry Permit in advance.

◎ Registered foreigners who have departed before April 1, 2022 with a Re-entry Permit should enter the ROK within the granted re-entry permit period (within l year), and should visit a Korean diplomatic mission abroad to extend the re-entry permit period in case entering the ROK within the relevant period is difficult due to COVID-19.

passages.title: Announcement on Changes in Re-entry Permit System
passages.file_name: Announcement on Changes in Re-entry Permit System.pdf
passages.snippet:
【 Announcement on Changes in Re-entry Permit System 】 This is to announce that Re-entry Permit System will change as specified below as all entrants from overseas are required to submit a negative COVID-19 PCR test certificate starting January 8 (Fri.), 2021 in response to recent spread of the highly transmissible new coronavirus strains.
□ Mandatory submission of negative COVID-19 PCR test certificate by foreigners issued with Re-entry Permit
• (Current) Foreigners re-entering the ROK with a Re-entry Permit are required to submit a negative COVID-19 PCR certificate, a medical certificate, or a medical examination exemption certificate.
• (After the Change) Foreigners re-entering the ROK with a Re-entry Permit are required to submit a negative COVID-19 PCR test certificate.
- A negative COVID-19 PCR test certificate is deemed valid only when issued within 72 hours prior to departure.
※ Application for ‘Medical Examination Exemption Certificate’ for Re-entry Permit is no longer available.
□ Date of Enforcement
• All foreigners entering the ROK are required to submit a negative COVID-19 PCR test certificate as of 00:00 January 8 (Fri.), 2021.
- Foreigners with a Re-entry Permit (including those exempted from medical examination) issued before January 8 (Fri.), 2021 are also required to submit a negative COVID-19 PCR test certificate if entering the nation after 00:00 January 8 (Fri.), 2021.

passages.title: Visa guide: C-3-1 Short-Term General
passages.snippet:
□ You are eligible to apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 1 year,
if you have visited the ROK or any OECD member country for one time and with no criminal and illegal immigration records
□ You are eligible to apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 3 years, if you are
1) A professional that requires a license recognized by a government such as doctor, lawyer, accountant, and others.
2) A faculty member positioned higher than an assistant professor at university (or vocational college), a teacher of elementary, middle, or high school
3) Well-known artists, entertainers and athletes acknowledged by the head of Korean diplomatic mission abroad
4) A person who has visited ROK as a group-tourist guide at a travel agency specialized in group tourists
* It refers to a tourist guide at a travel agency specialized in only assisting group tourists assembled by a designated travel agency only in contrast to a tourist guide of a group tourist agency in general.
5) A person who has visited the ROK or OECD member countries more than two times and has no criminal or illegal immigration records. (*Entry based on visa exemption or as a group tourist to Jeju is NOT counted as the number of visit to ROK)
6) A person who has visited the ROK with a Medical Tourist visa
7) A person who has proved his/her assets including real estate, financial assets, or business ownership worth more than 5,000,000 yuan

passages.title: Announcement Regarding Re-Entry Permit(Reimplementation of Re-Entry Permit Exemption as of April 1, 2022 after suspension due to COVID-19)
passages.snippet:
- 1 - Announcement Regarding Re-Entry Permit Reimplementation of Re-Entry Permit Exemption as of April 1, 2022 after suspension due to COVID-19 The Re-Entry Permit Exemption which has been suspended since June 1, 2020 will be reimplemented as of April 1, 2022 according to changes in COVID response in the nation.
◎ With the re-implementation of the nation’s Re-Entry Permit Exemption, registered foreign residents departing after April 1, 2022 will be allowed re-entry into the ROK within 1 year (2 years for permanent residents)
from the date of departure, without obtaining a Re-entry Permit in advance.
◎ Yet, registered foreign residents intending to re-enter the Republic of Korea after spending more than a year abroad from the date of departure should apply for a Multiple Re-entry Permit (granted for up to 2 years)
◎ Registered foreigners who have departed before April 1, 2022 with a Re-entry Permit should enter the ROK within the granted re-entry permit period (within l year), and should visit a Korean diplomatic mission abroad to extend the re-entry permit period in case entering the ROK within the relevant period is difficult due to COVID-19.
1. Persons Exempted from Re-entry Permit ▢ Those Exempted from Re-entry Permit ❍ (Registered Foreigners) Diplomat (A-1) through International Agreement
(A-3), Korean Arts and Culture (D-1) through Dependent Family
(F-3), Marriage Migrant (F-6) through Work and Visit (H-2) status holders for Re-entry into the ROK within 1 year from the date of departure

passages.title: Visa guide: C-3-1 Short-Term General
passages.snippet:
□ You are eligible to apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 1 year,
if you have visited the ROK or any OECD member country for one time and with no criminal and illegal immigration records
□ You are eligible to apply for a multiple-entry visa valid for 3 years, if you are
1) A professional that requires a license recognized by a government such as doctor, lawyer, accountant, and others.
2) A faculty member positioned higher than an assistant professor at university (or vocational college), a teacher of elementary, middle, or high school
3) Well-known artists, entertainers and athletes acknowledged by the head of Korean diplomatic mission abroad
4) A person who has visited ROK as a group-tourist guide at a travel agency specialized in group tourists
* It refers to a tourist guide at a travel agency specialized in only assisting group tourists assembled by a designated travel agency only in contrast to a tourist guide of a group tourist agency in general.
5) A person who has visited the ROK or OECD member countries more than two times and has no criminal or illegal immigration records. (*Entry based on visa exemption or as a group tourist to Jeju is NOT counted as the number of visit to ROK)
6) A person who has visited the ROK with a Medical Tourist visa
7) A person who has proved his/her assets including real estate, financial assets, or business ownership worth more than 5,000,000 yuan

【 Announcement on Changes in Re-entry Permit System 】 This is to announce that Re-entry Permit System will change as specified below as all entrants from overseas are required to submit a negative COVID-19 PCR test certificate starting January 8 (Fri.), 2021 in response to recent spread of the highly transmissible new coronavirus strains.
□ Mandatory submission of negative COVID-19 PCR test certificate by foreigners issued with Re-entry Permit
• (Current) Foreigners re-entering the ROK with a Re-entry Permit are required to submit a negative COVID-19 PCR certificate, a medical certificate, or a medical examination exemption certificate.
• (After the Change) Foreigners re-entering the ROK with a Re-entry Permit are required to submit a negative COVID-19 PCR test certificate.
- A negative COVID-19 PCR test certificate is deemed valid only when issued within 72 hours prior to departure.
※ Application for ‘Medical Examination Exemption Certificate’ for Re-entry Permit is no longer available.
□ Date of Enforcement
• All foreigners entering the ROK are required to submit a negative COVID-19 PCR test certificate as of 00:00 January 8 (Fri.), 2021.
- Foreigners with a Re-entry Permit (including those exempted from medical examination) issued before January 8 (Fri.), 2021 are also required to submit a negative COVID-19 PCR test certificate if entering the nation after 00:00 January 8 (Fri.), 2021.

passages.title: Announcement on Changes in Re-entry Permit System
passages.file_name: Announcement on Changes in Re-entry Permit System.pdf
passages.snippet:
【 Announcement on Changes in Re-entry Permit System 】 This is to announce that Re-entry Permit System will change as specified below as all entrants from overseas are required to submit a negative COVID-19 PCR test certificate starting January 8 (Fri.), 2021 in response to recent spread of the highly transmissible new coronavirus strains.
□ Mandatory submission of negative COVID-19 PCR test certificate by foreigners issued with Re-entry Permit
• (Current) Foreigners re-entering the ROK with a Re-entry Permit are required to submit a negative COVID-19 PCR certificate, a medical certificate, or a medical examination exemption certificate.
• (After the Change) Foreigners re-entering the ROK with a Re-entry Permit are required to submit a negative COVID-19 PCR test certificate.
- A negative COVID-19 PCR test certificate is deemed valid only when issued within 72 hours prior to departure.
※ Application for ‘Medical Examination Exemption Certificate’ for Re-entry Permit is no longer available.
□ Date of Enforcement
• All foreigners entering the ROK are required to submit a negative COVID-19 PCR test certificate as of 00:00 January 8 (Fri.), 2021.
- Foreigners with a Re-entry Permit (including those exempted from medical examination) issued before January 8 (Fri.), 2021 are also required to submit a negative COVID-19 PCR test certificate if entering the nation after 00:00 January 8 (Fri.), 2021.

citations.title: Introducing declaration of accommodation by short-term foreign residents
citations.snippet:
Declaration of accommodation by short-term foreign residents Visit Hi Korea website (www.hikorea.go.kr) or a dedicated website set up for this scheme (www.k-eta.go.kr/trds) for more information.
This schemes aims to minimise social/economic loss and ensure safety of the public by locating short-term residents' accommodation in a timely manner should a communicable disease outbreak or a terrorist attack takes place.
* Alerts are classified into four levels, namely: attention, caution, alert, and serious.
Declaration is required in the issuance of a crisis alert* of the "interest" level or higher in line with "Infectious Disease Control And Prevention Act" or in the issuance of a crisis alert* of the "caution" level of higher in line with "Act On Counter-terrorism For The Protection Of Citizens And Public Security".
Foreign residents holding short-term visas- B-1(Visa exempted), B-2(Tourism/transit), C-1(Short-term news coverage), C-3(Short-term visit), C-4(Short-term employment)
should present passport or a travel document to the owner of the accommodation facility.
A breach of this requirement will result in a fine up to KRW 500,000.
Accommodation facilities registed as a lodging business in line with Public Health Control Act or tourist accommodation business, city home-stay services for foreign tourists or Hanok experience business in line with Tourism Promotion Act should relay information of foreign guest (e.g. passport information)
via an information network designated by the Ministry of Justice.
A breach of this requirement will result in a fine up to KRW 500,000.
went into force as of 10 December 2020 as a measure to prevent the spread of communicable disease in the country

question: Which short-term visa types are covered by the accommodation declaration rule?
reference: B-1 (visa exempted), B-2 (tourism/transit), C-1, C-3 and C-4.
answer: The accommodation declaration rule covers foreign residents holding short-term visas B-1, B-2, C-1, C-3, and C-4 [1]. This list includes visa types such as Tourism/transit (B-2), Short-term news coverage (C-1), Short-term visit (C-3), and Short-term employment (C-4) [1]. The rule does not cover other short-term visa types like E-1, E-7, C-3-1, or specific business visitor sub-categories mentioned in other passages.

passages.snippet:
-
Persons who hold a visa (re-entry permit, permanent residency, etc.) to enter the United States, Canada, Australia, or New Zealand (hereinafter referred to as “the four advanced countries”) and
-
1) who go to one of the four advanced countries in transit through Korea; or
-
2) who stay in one of the four advanced countries and take a direct flight from the country to Korea to go to a country of nationality or a third country.
-
Please be noted that:
-
- If you are a U.S. visa holder who transit through Korea and Saipan to reach the U.S. as the final destination, you are permitted to enter Korea without a visa. (However, if you depart from the U.S. and enter Korea via Saipan, you are not granted no-visa entry to Korea.)
-
- If you are a Chinese group tourist holding a group-tourist visa to Japan and meet certain requirements (e.g. using a travel agency that only attracts Chinese group tourists), you are permitted to enter Korea without a visa.
-
- If you hold an e-visa to Australia and a visa label is attached to your passport, you are permitted to enter Korea without a visa. However, if the label is not on your passport, you are granted no-visa entry only when you depart from Australia and transit through Korea.

question: Was visa-free entry for Canadians suspended in 2020?
reference: Yes. Canada is listed among the 34 visa-free countries/regions whose visa-free entry was suspended.
answer: Yes, visa-free entry for Canadians was suspended in 2020. Canada is listed as one of the 34 countries eligible for visa-free entry after April 13, 2020 [1]. However, persons with a Canadian passport are required to obtain a visa from a Korean diplomatic mission to enter the Republic of Korea because they fall under the temporary suspension measures applied to 90 countries/regions as of April 13, 2020 [2].

citations.snippet:
Announcement of Label Free Visa Policy and Important Guidelines The Korean Embassies in the United States of America, Japan and 24 European Countries* no longer issue visa labels, as of 24th February, 2020.
* Europe (24 countries): Greece, Netherlands, Norway, Denmark, Germany, Romania, Belgium, Bulgaria, Serbia, Sweden, Switzerland, Spain, Slovakia, Ireland, United Kingdom, Austria, Italy, Czech Republic, Croatia, Portugal, Poland, France, Finland, Hungary
※ All Korean Embassies will stop issuing visa labels from 1st July, 2020.
When visa applications are approved, the Embassy will notify applicants of their visa details by issuing ‘Visa Grant Notice’. (Visa Application Center may issue the document on behalf of the Embassy). All applicants can print out the document at any time, by entering passport information (passport number, name and date of birth).
‘Visa Grant Notice’ document can be used to prove visa status, whether he/she is a holder of a valid Korean visa. Also, all visa holders are required to present the document to immigration officers during immigration clearance.
The document is valid printed either in color, or in black and white. Please refer to the ‘Note’ in the document for detailed information.
【How to verify and print out ‘Visa Grant Notice’】
1) Go to www.visa.go.kr - Application Status/Issue - Click ‘Check Application Status & Print’ menu. 2) Enter your Passport number, Name and Date of Birth, and Click the ‘Search’ button. 3) If your visa application is approved, the ‘Certificate’ button will be activated. 4) Click the button and print out the ‘Visa Grant Notice’.
* Please refer to attached file for more details.

question: How do I print my Visa Grant Notice, and does it need to be printed in colour?
reference: On visa.go.kr open Application Status/Issue > Check Application Status & Print, enter passport number, name and date of birth, search, and click the Certificate button to print; it is valid printed in colour or black and white.
answer: To print your Visa Grant Notice, visit www.visa.go.kr and click the 'Check Application Status & Print' menu, then enter your passport number, name, and date of birth [1]. You can also access this by clicking 'Check Application Status' followed by 'Check Application Status & Print' on the portal website [3]. The document does not need to be printed in color; it is valid whether printed in color or black and white [1]. All visa holders are required to present this document to immigration officers during clearance regardless of the print method used [2].

Announcement of Label Free Visa Policy and Important Guidelines The Korean Embassies in the United States of America, Japan and 24 European Countries* no longer issue visa labels, as of 24th February, 2020.
* Europe (24 countries): Greece, Netherlands, Norway, Denmark, Germany, Romania, Belgium, Bulgaria, Serbia, Sweden, Switzerland, Spain, Slovakia, Ireland, United Kingdom, Austria, Italy, Czech Republic, Croatia, Portugal, Poland, France, Finland, Hungary
※ All Korean Embassies will stop issuing visa labels from 1st July, 2020.
When visa applications are approved, the Embassy will notify applicants of their visa details by issuing ‘Visa Grant Notice’. (Visa Application Center may issue the document on behalf of the Embassy). All applicants can print out the document at any time, by entering passport information (passport number, name and date of birth).
‘Visa Grant Notice’ document can be used to prove visa status, whether he/she is a holder of a valid Korean visa. Also, all visa holders are required to present the document to immigration officers during immigration clearance.
The document is valid printed either in color, or in black and white. Please refer to the ‘Note’ in the document for detailed information.
【How to verify and print out ‘Visa Grant Notice’】
1) Go to www.visa.go.kr - Application Status/Issue - Click ‘Check Application Status & Print’ menu. 2) Enter your Passport number, Name and Date of Birth, and Click the ‘Search’ button. 3) If your visa application is approved, the ‘Certificate’ button will be activated. 4) Click the button and print out the ‘Visa Grant Notice’.
* Please refer to attached file for more details.

question: When can the Seoul Immigration Office temporarily suspend a group e-visa agency because of illegal stayers?
reference: When the number of illegal stayers exceeds 5 in one month, or 3 for each tour group.
answer: The Seoul Immigration Office may temporarily suspend a group e-Visa application agency's operation if the number of illegal stayers exceeds 5 during a 1-month period or 3 for each tour group [1].

question: Who can get a 10-year multiple-entry C-3 visa under the 2018 New Southern Policy measure?
reference: Professionals such as doctors, lawyers and professors, and holders of a bachelor's or higher degree from Korea or a master's or higher from overseas, from the listed New Southern Policy countries.
answer: Nationals of Myanmar, Cambodia, Sri Lanka, Indonesia, Laos, Nepal, Pakistan, the Philippines, Vietnam, India, and Bangladesh who are required to obtain a visa for entry into the ROK can get this visa [2]. Professionals such as doctors, lawyers, professors, CEOs of public/private enterprises, etc., who are highly unlikely to violate laws or regulations including illegal employment or staying in the nation are eligible [2]. Individuals with a bachelor's degree or higher from Korea, or a Master's degree or higher from overseas, are also eligible [2]. Assistant professors or higher at a university qualify for a 10-year multiple entry visa [5]. Private enterprises capitalized at 5 billion or above allow their CEOs to apply [5].

○ In line with this, entry procedures will be simplified for residents of Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City, Da Nang in Vietnam who have relatively high income, by issuing them multiple entry visas.
※ Whereas the annual per capita average income of Vietnam stands at $ 2,300 as of 2017, the income level rises to $ 5,538 in Ho Chi Minh City and $ 3,500 in Hanoi, which is estimated to double the respective figure considering that most houses in the region are dual-income families.
- 3 -

question: How much was the visa fee for Chinese group tourists that was waived after MERS, and until when was the waiver extended?
reference: About USD 15 per person; the waiver was extended to the end of 2016.

citations.file_name: 151221 PRESS RELEASE(Visa Fee Waiver Policy for Group Tourists).pdf
citations.snippet:
- 1 -
❍ The Ministry of Justice of the Republic of Korea extends the current visa fee waiver policy for group tourists through to the end of next year by reflecting the opinions of the tourism industry and relevant authorities.
Note: The Ministry has implemented visa fee wavier policy (effective from July 6, 2015 to Dec. 31, 2015) for group tourists from five countries (China, Vietnam, Indonesia, Philippines and Cambodia) following the MERS outbreak.

❍ The Ministry expects that the extended visa fee waiver policy would attract more group tourists from China and other countries and thereby significantly contribute to the revitalization of the Korean tourism industry and the economic recovery.

citations.title: The Ministry of Justice's Measures to Provide Convenient Entry to Foreign Tourists
citations.snippet:
- 1 - Press Release Embargoed until July 1, 2015 14:00 pm 2 pages Date July 1, 2015 Division Visa & Residence Division Director Kim, Young-guen
02) 2110-4055 Deputy Director Chang, Hee-jung
02) 2110-4067 Picture with pictures □ without pictures ■ Office of Spokesperson 02) 2110-3717 The Ministry of Justice's Measures to Provide Convenient Entry to Foreign Tourists
- Exemption of Visa Application Fees for Group Tourists
- Extension of Visa Expiration Date
- Expansion of No-visa Entry
❍ The Ministry of Justice of the Republic of Korea has decided to implement proactive measures such as exemption of visa application fees in order to provide foreign tourists with easier and convenient access to Korea and thereby support the concerned tourism industry following the recent Middle East Respiratory Syndrome (MERS) outbreak.
❍ The measures include:
1. First, exemption of visa application fees for group tourists from China and other countries for three months (from July 6 to September 30)
- Visa application fees for Chinese group tourists (currently about 15 US dollars per person) are exempt for three months to support attracting foreign tourists.
- The same exemption measure applies to four Southeast Asian countries (Vietnam, Philippines, Indonesia and Cambodia) to which group tourist visas
- 2 - are issued.
2. Second, validity extension of single-entry visas that were issued before and after the MERS development (from March 1 to June 30, 2015) from the current three months to six months
- Persons subject to the extension are allowed to enter the Republic of Korea even after the visa expiration date, which would prevent them from going through inconvenient procedures such as visiting a diplomatic mission to have their visa extended.
Note: About 1.09 million foreigners were granted a single-entry visa from March to June 2015. The Ministry will promote relevant information through diplomatic missions in China and other countries so that foreigners can benefit from it.
3. Third, no-visa entry for Chinese group tourists holding a Japanese group tourist visa
- About 1.1 million chinese group tourists were granted a Japanese group tourist visa in 2014. The no-visa entry is expected to provide Chinese tourists travelling Japan with easier and convenient access to Korea so that they can enjoy tourism activities while staying in the country for a maximum of 15 days.
- At the same time, the Ministry will prepare restrictive measures to eliminate concerns over illegal stays of tourists that may be caused by the implementation of the measure in order to minimize possible side effects.
❍ The above measures were designed to dispel public concerns over the tourism industry following the MERS outbreak and to support foreigners with easier and convenient access to Korea. The Ministry of Justice expects the measures to contribute to revitalizing the tourism industry and the Korean economy.

question: What happens to a real estate immigrant investor's status if they lease or sell the property?
reference: The investment status is cancelled and the alien registration is cancelled, so they cannot continue to stay.
answer: If a real estate immigrant investor leases or sells the estate, their status will be cancelled [1]. Consequently, they will not be able to continue their stay in Korea [2]. This cancellation applies regardless of whether other investment requirements are met during the investment period [3].

citations.title: Korea Investment Immigration Center Real Estate Investor Scheme Guide
citations.snippet:
Investment Guide for Investors for the Real Estate Immigrant Investor Scheme This guide outlines relevant details for investors for the Immigrant Investor Scheme for Real Estate.
A. (Maintaining Investment Status) Please be warned that your status will be cancelled if you lease or sold the estate, or if your estate becomes foreclosed or is set up for mortgage.

신청인 Applicant 성명 Full Name 여권번호(외국인등록번호)
Passport No.(Alien Registration No.)

Following regulations in sojourn administration guidelines of foreign investors, I request the pre-investigation of my sojourn suitability as it is written above, and will never raise objections even if the final decision is different from the result of pre-investigation due to condition changes in future.
Date: 년 YYYY 월 MM 일 DD장 신청인 Applicant :
(서명 또는 인)
(Sign or stamp)
○○○출입국관리사무소장(출장소장) 귀하 To Chief, ○○○Immigration(Branch) Office 첨부 : 신분증사본 1부. (1 copy of ID card)
사 전 심 사 결 과 事先审查结果
□ 적합 / □ 부적합 Approved Disapproved 확인자Confirmer (서명 또는 인)
(Sign or stamp)
유의사항 Matters to be attended to
1. 사전심사안내는 투자금액 등 투자요건을 갖추었을 경우 신청인에 대한 각종 체류허가 등 가능여부에 대하여 사전에 확인해주는 것이며, 실제로 체류허가를 결정하는 것은 아닙니다. Pre-investigation is only for checking possibilities of various sojourn related businesses in advance when the applicant satisfies investment conditions such as investment money. It does not make an actual decision about sojourn related businesses.
2. 사전심사안내를 받은 이후 국내법 위반 및 기타 사정변경 등이 있을 경우 실제 체류허가 등 신청 시에는 사전안내와 다르게 결정될 수 있습니다.
In case of violating domestic laws or other condition changes, your apply for sojourn related businesses can be decided in a different way other than pre-investigation.

question: How often must a real estate immigrant investor with alien registration come to Korea?
reference: At least once within one year from the date of departure, or the alien registration is cancelled.
answer: A real estate immigrant investor with alien registration must come to Korea at least once within one year from the date of departure [1]. Failure to do so results in the cancellation of their alien registration [2].

B. (Working or Engaging in Economic Activities) When you have an investor visa, you are free to work, study, and involve in economic activities, however, you must not engage in any speculative behavior or sell or work in an industry that hinders public good and custom.
C. (Re-entry Period) If you have done your alien registration already, you must come to Korea at least once within one year from the date of departure, otherwise, your alien registration will be cancelled.
D. (Extending the Period of Stay) You must come to Korea and get an extension from an immigration office BEFORE your visa expires, otherwise, your alien registration will be cancelled.
E. (Giving a Consent to the Use of Personal Information) Please note that, by laws, all agents who sell their real estate properties to others must check the lease status, mortgage, sale or foreclosure of their individual buyers and report to the Immigration Office every May and November.
F. (Other Remarks) For more information, please check our website at www.visa.go.kr or contact the Korea Investment Immigration Center (☏ 032-740-7888, 7788) and your jurisdictional immigration office.

question: For how long is a letter of attorney for a foreign investor's applications valid?
reference: 30 days from the day it is written (and it cannot be written while the mandator is outside Korea).
answer: A letter of attorney for various applications is only valid for 30 days from the day it is written [1]. This validity period also applies to letters of attorney used for foreign investors' applications [2].

□ When Applying to Provide Child-raising Support
① Documents to Be Prepared by Inviter: copy of ID, Invitation Letter, Letter of Guarantee (guarantee period: 3 years from entry date), Pledge for Prevention of Illegal Stay or Employment, proof of residence (lease agreement, etc)
② Documents to Be Prepared by the Invitee: visa application form, passport, photo in a standard format, fee
③ Proof of Family Relation in Korea: Inviter’s Basic Certificate, Family Relation Certificate, Marriage Relation Certificate, copy of Resident Registration, Family Relation Certificate under the name of the inviter’s child (If the inviter is pregnant, Pregnancy Certificate or maternity note)
※ Inviters with two or more children must provide a Family Relation Certificate for each child.
④ Proof of Family Relation in Home Country: proof of family relation showing all immediate family members and siblings of the inviter (an official document issued by the government of the inviter’s home country)
※ When inviting family members other than parents, additional documents are required: a document proving both parents'' inability to enter Korea, and a document showing the immediate family members of the invitee.
⑤ For Inviters with School-Age Children: Certificate of Enrollment of the child
□ When Applying to Provide Humanitarian Support
①-④ Same documents as listed in ① to ④ above

passages.title: Visa guide: C-4 Short-Term Employee
passages.snippet:
1. Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
2. Additional documents for each case
Case 1) A recommendation letter from the Korea Media Rating Board (Some performances are exempt from submitting the letter), Performance Outline
Case 2) A performance recommendation letter by the Korea Media Rating Board, Entertainment activities outline, A certificate proving your qualification or experiences, A letter of guarantee
Case 3) An Invitation card or attendance confirmation issued by the host institution, A contract that indicates the wages/incentives for participating events (If such details are written on the invitation card, you do not have to submit the contract)
Case 4) An employment recommendation letter by the Minister of a respective department or a document proving the necessity of hiring**
* An employment recommendation letter from the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism for advertisement, fashion models and a recommendation letter from the Ministry of Science, ICT, and Future Planning
** An employment recommendation letter from respective athletic clubs (associations) for athletes, coaches, judges OR an official document requesting for a visa cooperation from the Minister of respective departments OR a document explaining the purposes and outlines of invitations/businesses OR a confirmation issuance from the host institution for participants in athletic, badook, and singing competitions which gives out cash prizes

passages.title: Visa guide: F-5-11 Special talent
passages.snippet:
1. Common documents
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② Personal Statements
③ Documents proving your annual incomes
④ Documents proving that you have published your research paper in a prominent journal, such as SCI (Science Citation Index), or documents proving your research achievement(s).
⑤ A letter of guarantee
⑥ Degree and other materials(Awards History in relevant field, Certificates of your career experiences)
2. Additional documents for each case
① Science Field: A recommendation letter from the Minister of Science, ICT and Future Planning for Science / a recommendation letter from the Minister of Education for Education
② Education Field: A recommendation letter from the Minister of Education
③ If you are in Business Management, you need to submit a recommendation letter from the head of the Korea Chamber of Commerce＆Industry, the Korea Trade Investment Promotion Agency, or the Federation of Korean Industry
※ If you worked as a multinational manager or an executive at a company listed on the Top 500 companies of the world, you need to submit A proof of employment or a certificate of your career experience that can prove your work experiences.
④ Culture and Sports Area: A recommendation letter from the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism for those in culture and sports industry
※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

passages.title: Visa guide: F-2-2 Underage children of Korean National
passages.snippet:
① Visa Application Form (Form No. 17), passport, a photo in a standard format, fee
② Official documents proving that the applicant is a minor of a Korean national
③ Documents proving the relation between a Korean national and an underage child, and the relation of custodianship.

※ The head of Korean diplomatic missions abroad may request for additional documents depending on the condition of the country of residence/jurisdiction if it is deemed necessary for visa evaluation.

question: Within how many days of arriving in Korea must an E-2 visa holder apply for an alien registration card?
reference: Within 90 days, submitting a health certificate from a hospital designated by the Korean government.
answer: An E-2 visa holder must apply for an Alien Registration card within 90 days of arriving in Korea [1].

question: What kind of photo is required on the visa application form?
reference: A 35mm x 45mm colour photo taken within the last 6 months, full face without a hat, front view against a white or off-white background.
answer: A color photo taken within the last 6 months is required. The photo must be a full face view without a hat against a white or off-white background. This applies to both the Visa Application Form and the Application for Certificate of Visa Eligibility [1][3].

You are eligible to apply for this visa if you are
A parent of a person satisfying the following requirements and a parent of the person's spouse

(Korean Wave) such as K-POP, etc.

passages.title: The Ministry of Justice's Measures to Provide Convenient Entry to Foreign Tourists
passages.snippet:
- 1 - Press Release Embargoed until July 1, 2015 14:00 pm 2 pages Date July 1, 2015 Division Visa & Residence Division Director Kim, Young-guen
02) 2110-4055 Deputy Director Chang, Hee-jung
02) 2110-4067 Picture with pictures □ without pictures ■ Office of Spokesperson 02) 2110-3717 The Ministry of Justice's Measures to Provide Convenient Entry to Foreign Tourists
- Exemption of Visa Application Fees for Group Tourists
- Extension of Visa Expiration Date
- Expansion of No-visa Entry
❍ The Ministry of Justice of the Republic of Korea has decided to implement proactive measures such as exemption of visa application fees in order to provide foreign tourists with easier and convenient access to Korea and thereby support the concerned tourism industry following the recent Middle East Respiratory Syndrome (MERS) outbreak.
❍ The measures include:
1. First, exemption of visa application fees for group tourists from China and other countries for three months (from July 6 to September 30)
- Visa application fees for Chinese group tourists (currently about 15 US dollars per person) are exempt for three months to support attracting foreign tourists.
- The same exemption measure applies to four Southeast Asian countries (Vietnam, Philippines, Indonesia and Cambodia) to which group tourist visas
- 2 - are issued.
2. Second, validity extension of single-entry visas that were issued before and after the MERS development (from March 1 to June 30, 2015) from the current three months to six months
- Persons subject to the extension are allowed to enter the Republic of Korea even after the visa expiration date, which would prevent them from going through inconvenient procedures such as visiting a diplomatic mission to have their visa extended.
Note: About 1.09 million foreigners were granted a single-entry visa from March to June 2015. The Ministry will promote relevant information through diplomatic missions in China and other countries so that foreigners can benefit from it.
3. Third, no-visa entry for Chinese group tourists holding a Japanese group tourist visa
- About 1.1 million chinese group tourists were granted a Japanese group tourist visa in 2014. The no-visa entry is expected to provide Chinese tourists travelling Japan with easier and convenient access to Korea so that they can enjoy tourism activities while staying in the country for a maximum of 15 days.
- At the same time, the Ministry will prepare restrictive measures to eliminate concerns over illegal stays of tourists that may be caused by the implementation of the measure in order to minimize possible side effects.
❍ The above measures were designed to dispel public concerns over the tourism industry following the MERS outbreak and to support foreigners with easier and convenient access to Korea. The Ministry of Justice expects the measures to contribute to revitalizing the tourism industry and the Korean economy.

passages.file_name: 151221 PRESS RELEASE(Visa Fee Waiver Policy for Group Tourists).pdf
passages.snippet:
- 1 -
❍ The Ministry of Justice of the Republic of Korea extends the current visa fee waiver policy for group tourists through to the end of next year by reflecting the opinions of the tourism industry and relevant authorities.
Note: The Ministry has implemented visa fee wavier policy (effective from July 6, 2015 to Dec. 31, 2015) for group tourists from five countries (China, Vietnam, Indonesia, Philippines and Cambodia) following the MERS outbreak.
❍ The number of Chinese tourists to Korea fell sharply in the wake of the MERS outbreak this year. While it has shown signs of recovery since August, it still remains around 74% of the last year’s arrivals.
❍ In proactive support of attracting group tourists for the “2016 Visit Korea Year”, the Ministry of Justice came to an agreement to extend the current visa fee* waiver policy for group tourists to the end of 2016. (*About USD 15 per person)
❍ The Ministry expects that the extended visa fee waiver policy would attract more group tourists from China and other countries and thereby significantly contribute to the revitalization of the Korean tourism industry and the economic recovery.

passages.title: Announcement Regarding Re-Entry Permit(Reimplementation of Re-Entry Permit Exemption as of April 1, 2022 after suspension due to COVID-19)
passages.snippet:
- 1 - Announcement Regarding Re-Entry Permit Reimplementation of Re-Entry Permit Exemption as of April 1, 2022 after suspension due to COVID-19 The Re-Entry Permit Exemption which has been suspended since June 1, 2020 will be reimplemented as of April 1, 2022 according to changes in COVID response in the nation.
◎ With the re-implementation of the nation’s Re-Entry Permit Exemption, registered foreign residents departing after April 1, 2022 will be allowed re-entry into the ROK within 1 year (2 years for permanent residents)
from the date of departure, without obtaining a Re-entry Permit in advance.
◎ Yet, registered foreign residents intending to re-enter the Republic of Korea after spending more than a year abroad from the date of departure should apply for a Multiple Re-entry Permit (granted for up to 2 years)
◎ Registered foreigners who have departed before April 1, 2022 with a Re-entry Permit should enter the ROK within the granted re-entry permit period (within l year), and should visit a Korean diplomatic mission abroad to extend the re-entry permit period in case entering the ROK within the relevant period is difficult due to COVID-19.
1. Persons Exempted from Re-entry Permit ▢ Those Exempted from Re-entry Permit ❍ (Registered Foreigners) Diplomat (A-1) through International Agreement
(A-3), Korean Arts and Culture (D-1) through Dependent Family
(F-3), Marriage Migrant (F-6) through Work and Visit (H-2) status holders for Re-entry into the ROK within 1 year from the date of departure
- 2 -
※ Re-entry will be allowed until the validity of stay for persons with period of stay of less than l year ❍ (Permanent Resident, F-5) For re-entry within 2 years from the date of departure
❍ (Overseas Korean, F-4) For re-entry within authorized period of stay
❍ (Holders of Refugee Travel Document) For re-entry within validity period of the document
❍ (Those from Exempted Countries) For re-entry of nationals from Exempted Countries* within authorized period of stay
* (13 Countries) Republic of Suriname, Netherlands, Norway, Denmark, Germany, Luxembourg, Belgium, Sweden, Switzerland, Liechtenstein, France, Finland, Chile (D-7, D-8, D-9)
▢ Re-Entry Permit Exemption Ineligibility
❍ Persons banned from entering Korea and persons to whom visa issuance is prohibited will need additional review procedures and re-entry permit can be restricted → Please inquire at immigration offices
2. Those required to apply for Re-entry Permit  Applying for Multiple Re-Entry Permit

question: Which documents can an F-6-1 marriage migrant submit to prove they can communicate in Korean?
reference: One of - a TOPIK report card, a designated educational organization certificate, a certificate of a degree in Korean language, documents proving you are an overseas Korean with foreign nationality, or documents proving you lived in Korea for one year or more.

◎ With the re-implementation of the nation’s Re-Entry Permit Exemption, registered foreign residents departing after April 1, 2022 will be allowed re-entry into the ROK within 1 year (2 years for permanent residents)
from the date of departure, without obtaining a Re-entry Permit in advance.
◎ Yet, registered foreign residents intending to re-enter the Republic of Korea after spending more than a year abroad from the date of departure should apply for a Multiple Re-entry Permit (granted for up to 2 years)
◎ Registered foreigners who have departed before April 1, 2022 with a Re-entry Permit should enter the ROK within the granted re-entry permit period (within l year), and should visit a Korean diplomatic mission abroad to extend the re-entry permit period in case entering the ROK within the relevant period is difficult due to COVID-19.
1. Persons Exempted from Re-entry Permit ▢ Those Exempted from Re-entry Permit ❍ (Registered Foreigners) Diplomat (A-1) through International Agreement
(A-3), Korean Arts and Culture (D-1) through Dependent Family
(F-3), Marriage Migrant (F-6) through Work and Visit (H-2) status holders for Re-entry into the ROK within 1 year from the date of departure
- 2 -
※ Re-entry will be allowed until the validity of stay for persons with period of stay of less than l year ❍ (Permanent Resident, F-5) For re-entry within 2 years from the date of departure
❍ (Overseas Korean, F-4) For re-entry within authorized period of stay
❍ (Holders of Refugee Travel Document) For re-entry within validity period of the document

(제1쪽 / Page1)
외국인 배우자의 결혼배경 진술서 (Personal Details Form for a Marriage Migrant Visa)
<유의사항>
‣ 이 진술서는 결혼동거 목적의 사증발급 또는 체류자격 변경허가를 받으려는 해당 외국인(신청인)이 작성합니다.
‣ 원칙적으로 이 서류에 기재된 정보에 따라 심사가 진행되니 영사 및 출입국관리공무원이 심사에 참고할 수 있도록 신청인께서는 해당하는 모든 질문에 답변하시고, 답변과 관련된 입증서류가 있는 경우 모두 제출하시기 바랍니다.
‣ 해당하는 답변을 누락하거나 입증서류를 제출하지 않은 경우에는 심사가 지연되거나 불허될 수 있습니다.
‣ 만약 사증발급이나 체류자격 변경허가에 필요한 요건을 갖추지 못하였거나 요건을 입증하는 서류가 없음에도 거 짓된 사실을 기재하거나 위ㆍ변조된 서류를 제출하는 경우에는 관련 법령에 따라 처벌될 뿐만 아니라, 한국 입 국이 금지될 수 있습니다.

‣ This form must be completed by a person who apply for a marriage migrant visa or a change of visa status.
‣ In principle, the evaluation of the visa application will be based on the information provided on this personal details form.
‣ Therefore, the applicant should answer all questions to the best of his/her knowledge and submit relevant documentation in order for the consul or the immigration officer to use it as a reference.
‣ If a necessary answer has been omitted or any relevant documentation has not been submitted, the application process may be delayed or result in a disapproval.
‣ If conditions are not met for the visa or falsified information and/or documentation are forged to meet the conditions required to receive the visa, you will be not only penalized under the relevant statute, but also banned from entering the Republic of Korea.
‣ If you are unable to provide proper documentation, submit a statement stating the reason.
‣ The information you provide in this form will be protected according to the Personal Information Protection Act, and will only be used for matters governed by the Immigration Act.
